$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.check.haxe.loops. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-BOOL-LOOP-USING-COVERED-KEPT
arms.note: a covered insert byte hands back the ungrouped rewrites again, so `prefer-exists` / `prefer-foreach` write extension calls with no `using Lambda;` to bind them

arms.name: M-FIND-CONFLICT-SILENT
arms.note: the second copy of the same branch goes silent again

arms.name: M-BOOL-LOOP-CONFLICT-SILENT
arms.note: the third copy, the one `prefer-exists` and `prefer-foreach` share, goes silent again

arms.name: M-FIND-CONFLICT-MIS-ATTRIBUTED
arms.note: the conflict sentence is written on every finding the rule reported again, including the ones the candidate map never matched

arms.name: M-PM-ANY-ITERABLE
arms.note: a List comprehension becomes ls.map, which returns a List

arms.name: M-PM-FILTER
arms.note: an if without else, a filter, becomes a map over every element

arms.name: M-PM-LEAVING
arms.note: a block, a declaration, a nested loop or a try body is wrapped in a lambda

arms.name: M-PM-READS-BINDER
arms.note: a body that never reads the binder is mapped

arms.name: M-PM-BARE-BINDER
arms.note: the bare binder becomes the identity map

arms.name: M-PM-BINDER-WRITE
arms.note: a body that writes the binder is moved into a lambda

arms.name: M-PM-EXIT-KINDS
arms.note: a return, break, continue or throw in expression position is moved into a closure

arms.name: M-PM-BIND-COMMENT
arms.note: the bind spelling drops a comment inside the body

arms.name: M-PM-GAP-COMMENT
arms.note: a comment in the text the rewrite drops around the iterable and the body goes with it

arms.name: M-PSP-ANY-RECEIVER
arms.note: a List chain is rewritten into a comprehension or an Array-only call

arms.name: M-PSP-PURE
arms.note: a second body that calls something unproven pure is merged and moves relative to the first

arms.name: M-PSP-THROW
arms.note: two bodies that can both throw are interleaved and a different exception surfaces

arms.name: M-PSP-MAPMAP-FIRST
arms.note: a throwing first map body is merged under a second body that may skip it

arms.name: M-PSP-CAPTURE
arms.note: a second-body read of the first binders name is captured by it

arms.name: M-PSP-SINGLE-READ
arms.note: a second map body reading the result twice runs the first twice, reading it never drops the first

arms.name: M-PSP-AND-WRAP
arms.note: an operand binding looser than && joins unparenthesised and changes meaning

arms.name: M-PSP-TYPED-PARAM
arms.note: a typed, defaulted or optional lambda parameter is merged and its annotation dropped

arms.name: M-PSP-COMMENT
arms.note: a comment between the two lambdas goes with the rewrite punctuation

arms.name: M-PREFER-MAP-IDENTITY-UNWIRED
arms.note: prefer-map names no identity of its own again, so the rewrite its message quotes keys the finding

arms.name: M-IM-ALWAYS-CHAINED
arms.note: every map is taken for one a copying call follows, so a lone ascription hands back the very array it widens

arms.name: M-IM-CHAIN-COPIES
arms.note: a map that feeds concat / filter / slice gets a copy of its own as well

arms.name: M-IM-ARRAY-ONLY
arms.note: a List or an iterator map is rewritten to an array

arms.name: M-IM-VALUE-TYPE
arms.note: an Int / Float / Bool element is ascribed as an array, which the compiler unifies and a static target lays out differently

arms.name: M-IM-REAL-MAP
arms.note: every body is taken for the binder, so a real mapping is rewritten to the array it maps

arms.name: M-IM-COMMENT
arms.note: a comment in the text the rewrite drops goes with it

arms.name: M-PM-ASCRIBED-BINDER
arms.note: an ascribed binder becomes the identity map xs.map(x -> (x : T))

arms.name: M-IM-NO-FIX
arms.note: the rule reports but never rewrites, so the compiler-accepted widening stays as written

arms.name: M-IM-OVER-VALUE-TYPE
arms.find: if (next != null && overValueType(next, r.file, r.type.span.from, index, s, hops - 1)) return true;
arms.note: an abstract or alias over a value type is taken for a reference type
